Class VulkanRenderModuleSwapChain

java.lang.Object
io.codetoil.curved_spacetime.render.vulkan.VulkanRenderModuleSwapChain
public class VulkanRenderModuleSwapChain extends Object
The swap chain: the queue of images the GPU renders into and the surface presents.

Its configuration is negotiated rather than chosen. The image count, extent, and pixel format are all clamped to what the surface reports it can do, so the requested values are treated as preferences. Present mode follows the vsync setting: FIFO waits for the display's refresh, immediate does not.

A swap chain is tied to the surface's dimensions, so resizing a window invalidates it and it must be rebuilt.

  • Constructor Details

    • VulkanRenderModuleSwapChain

      public VulkanRenderModuleSwapChain(VulkanModuleLogicalDevice vulkanModuleLogicalDevice, VulkanRenderModuleSurface surface, RenderModuleWindow renderModuleWindow, int requestedImages, boolean vsync, Logger logger)
      Creates a swap chain against the given surface.

      The requested image count is clamped to the surface's supported range, and the extent to its supported bounds, so the resulting swap chain may differ from what was asked for.

      Parameters:
      vulkanModuleLogicalDevice - the device to create the swap chain on
      surface - the surface to present to
      renderModuleWindow - the window supplying the fallback extent
      requestedImages - how many images are wanted, subject to surface limits
      vsync - whether to wait for the display's refresh when presenting
      logger - the logger to write swap chain diagnostics to
      Throws:
      AssertionError - if the swap chain or its image views cannot be created
